body.message:
Yes, still available! To answer everything at once:

"Last month" means when you move in, you pay the first month rent upfront plus the last month rent as a deposit to secure the unit. So your total to move in is AED 15,500, broken down as: first month AED 7,000, last month AED 7,000, and a refundable security deposit of AED 1,500. After that it's just AED 7,000 every month.

On the floor, let me get that confirmed for you. And since you've already seen a unit in the building today, you know what you're getting. Just come in, pay, and you're good to move in. What time works for you?
